thread:
aisha: quick heads-up from today's SageWorks onboarding call — they have two new asks: a "labs" research team that wants a sandbox for experimentation, and a high-throughput ingest pipeline that will push embeddings at ~5k docs/min steady with bursts. They asked about bulk import, streaming ingest support, dedup + prefix caching, and an order-of-magnitude cost estimate for ~10M embedding units/month. can we triage?

tom: looping infra + pricing for sizing. do we have a recommended Dedicated config for sustained 5k/min embeddings with occasional 3x bursts? @devon any initial thoughts?

jeff: flagging commercial angle — customer hinted they'd consolidate workloads if we can offer predictable pricing + a pilot. this is a clear expansion opportunity.

devon: quick gut-check numbers below (very rough): sustained 5k/min -> ~300k/hr -> ~7.2M/day. for embeddings I'd suggest a small Dedicated pool with async workers + KV/prefix cache. candidate config: 
```
model: embed-dense-1
pool: 2 x A40 (or 1xA100 depending on availability)
batch_size: 512
ingest_workers: 8
kv_cache: enabled
autoscale: target_cpu_then_gpu_burst
```
This should handle steady throughput and short bursts. We can tighten once we see qps distribution. :thumbsup:

karina: product-side: we can enable bulk-import APIs + incremental dedup on Dedicated and Private. For Hosted we'd recommend the S3 bulk-upload job which supports parallel jobs and backpressure. I'll draft a short enablement doc and a 1-pager showing tradeoffs (latency vs cost).

aisha: customer also wants a timeboxed sandbox for the labs team to experiment with reranking + streaming summarization pipelines. can we offer a 4-week demo pod (isolated) or recommend best-effort hosted approach? they'd like an onboarding checklist for the labs folks.

jeff: recommend a 4-week dev pod trial (shared dev capacity) with conversion path to reserved capacity. propose 30% trial discount, pending finance/legal. We should prepare an addendum for trial terms.

tom: I'll own the tech scoping. @aisha please drop the sample dataset and expected QPS curve so I can produce a finer sizing estimate. ops-bot: please create a task for quote + infra sizing.

ops-bot: Ticket CS-4987 created: "SageWorks - labs sandbox + embed ingest sizing". Assigned: tom, devon. Due: 3 business days.

aisha: dataset samples uploaded to drives/redwood/sageworks/samples (internal link). i'll sync with them tomorrow 10:00am PT to align on burst patterns and retention. thanks all :pray:

ops-bot: Reminder: capacity planning sync Thu 09:00am. Tagging: @devon @tom.

devon: one more note — if they plan nightly reruns, we'll need to account for batch window CPU + temporary storage. i'll add recommended buffer in the sizing doc.

karina: I'll put together the enablement slides + a short FAQ for the labs team (how to run experiments without impacting production). aiming to share by EOD Friday.

aisha: perfect. next steps: tom sizing + devon's revised config, karina enablement deck, jeff commercial terms draft. i'll update CS-4987 with outcomes after tomorrow's call. :heart:
